sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: To begin, there's someone our producer, Sam Greenspan, would like you to meet.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们的制作人萨姆·格林斯潘想让你见一个人。

sentences.en: Can you say who you are and how you know me?
sentences.zh: 你能说一下你是谁，以及你是怎么认识我的吗？

sentences.en: I'm your grandmother.
sentences.zh: 我是你奶奶。

sentences.en: My name is Jean Greenspan and I'm Sam Greenspan's grandmother.
sentences.zh: 我叫简·格林斯潘，是萨姆·格林斯潘的奶奶。

sentences.en: Jean Greenspan is my father's mother.
sentences.zh: 简·格林斯潘是我父亲的母亲。

sentences.en: I call her Grandma Jeannie.
sentences.zh: 我叫她珍妮奶奶。

sentences.en: She grew up during the Great Depression, and because her family got a lot of help from FDR and the New Deal,
sentences.zh: 她在经济大萧条时期长大，因为她的家庭从富兰克林·罗斯福和“新政”中得到了很多帮助，

sentences.en: Grandma Jeannie is a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 所以珍妮奶奶是一位民主党人。

sentences.en: Always has been, always will be.
sentences.zh: 一直都是，以后也永远是。

sentences.en: Grandma, have you ever voted for a Republican or anyone who wasn't a Democrat?
sentences.zh: 奶奶，你有没有投过共和党人，或者任何非民主党人的票？

sentences.en: No, no, no, no, not at all.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不，完全没有。

sentences.en: No, never, never, never do that.
sentences.zh: 不，从来没有，从来没有做过那种事。

sentences.en: Always vote for a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 我总是投民主党人的票。

sentences.en: And so on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November in the year 2000,
sentences.zh: 所以在2000年11月第一个星期一之后的第一个星期二，

sentences.en: Grandma Jeannie hopped on her three-wheel bike and pedaled over to the community center in her retirement village.
sentences.zh: 珍妮奶奶骑上她的三轮车，蹬到了她养老社区的活动中心。

sentences.en: And she did what she always does.
sentences.zh: 她做了她一贯会做的事。

sentences.en: She voted a straight Democratic ticket.
sentences.zh: 她投了民主党候选人的全票。

sentences.en: Or at least she thought she did.
sentences.zh: 或者至少她以为她是这么投的。

sentences.en: Grandma, can you tell me where you live?
sentences.zh: 奶奶，你能告诉我你住在哪儿吗？

sentences.en: Oh, and now I live in Century Village, West Palm Beach, in Florida.
sentences.zh: 哦，我现在住在佛罗里达州西棕榈滩的世纪村。

sentences.en: And what county do you live in?
sentences.zh: 你住在哪个县？

sentences.en: What county?
sentences.zh: 哪个县？

sentences.en: Palm Beach County.
sentences.zh: 棕榈滩县。

sentences.en: An election in turmoil.
sentences.zh: 一场陷入混乱的选举。

sentences.en: A presidency in the balance.
sentences.zh: 总统宝座悬而未决。

sentences.en: Who will emerge the winner in the historic Florida recount?
sentences.zh: 谁将成为佛罗里达州历史性重新计票中的赢家？

sentences.en: I believe the people of Palm Beach County have entrusted us to voice their right to participate in their government.
sentences.zh: 我相信棕榈滩县的人民已经委托我们来表达他们参与政府的权利。

sentences.en: I move that this board conduct a manual recount of all the ballots for the presidential election for the year 2000.
sentences.zh: 我提议本委员会对2000年总统选举的所有选票进行人工重新计票。

sentences.en: The election was close.
sentences.zh: 选举结果非常接近。

sentences.en: But tonight, after a count and yet another manual recount,
sentences.zh: 但今晚，在经过计票和又一次人工重新计票后，

sentences.en: Secretary Cheney and I are honored and humbled to have won the state of Florida,
sentences.zh: 切尼秘书和我感到非常荣幸和谦卑，能够赢得佛罗里达州，

sentences.en: which gives us the needed electoral votes to win the election.
sentences.zh: 这给了我们赢得选举所需的选举人票。

sentences.en: As a quick refresher, the 2000 presidential race between Republican George W.
sentences.zh: 简单回顾一下，2000年共和党人乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush and Democrat Al Gore
sentences.zh: 布什与民主党人阿尔·戈尔之间的总统竞选，

sentences.en: came down to contested votes in Florida.
sentences.zh: 归结为佛罗里达州有争议的选票。

sentences.en: And one of the four counties at the center of the controversy was Palm Beach County.
sentences.zh: 而争议中心的四个县之一就是棕榈滩县。

sentences.en: Voters were using paper ballots, where you indicate your choice by punching out holes with a metal stick.
sentences.zh: 选民当时使用的是纸质选票，你需要用金属棒戳出孔洞来表明你的选择。

sentences.en: Palm Beach County's ballot, known as the Butterfly Ballot,
sentences.zh: 棕榈滩县的选票，被称为“蝴蝶选票”，

sentences.en: had choices of candidates spread over two pages, with the holes to punch out in between them.
sentences.zh: 将候选人选项分布在两页纸上，中间是需要戳出的孔洞。

sentences.en: But some found the layout confusing.
sentences.zh: 但有些人觉得这种布局令人困惑。

sentences.en: Voters who wanted to cast their vote for George W.
sentences.zh: 想要投票给乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush had no problem.
sentences.zh: 布什的选民没有问题。

sentences.en: It was clear that the correct hole to punch was the very first one, right at the top.
sentences.zh: 很明显，正确的戳孔位置就是最上面的第一个。

sentences.en: But there was some ambiguity about which was the right hole to punch to indicate a vote for Al Gore.
sentences.zh: 但对于哪个才是投票给阿尔·戈尔的正确孔洞，存在一些歧义。

sentences.en: Was it the second one down, right after Bush?
sentences.zh: 是布什下面的第二个吗？

sentences.en: Or was it the third one down?
sentences.zh: 还是下面第三个？

sentences.en: Gore was actually the third one down.
sentences.zh: 戈尔实际上是下面第三个。

sentences.en: The way the ballot was set up, some voters who believed they were voting for Al Gore
sentences.zh: 由于选票的设置方式，一些相信自己是在投给阿尔·戈尔的选民，

sentences.en: actually cast a vote for Patrick Buchanan.
sentences.zh: 实际上投给了帕特里克·布坎南。

sentences.en: Buchanan being the extremely conservative Reform Party candidate.
sentences.zh: 布坎南是极度保守的改革党候选人。

sentences.en: And there was also a problem with the physical ballots themselves.
sentences.zh: 而且选票本身也存在物理问题。

sentences.en: Namely, the Chads.
sentences.zh: 也就是“渣屑”。

sentences.en: When you punch a hole in something, the Chad is the little piece of paper or cardboard or whatever it is that gets punched out.
sentences.zh: 当你戳穿某物时，“渣屑”就是被戳出来的那一小片纸或纸板之类的东西。

sentences.en: And in theory, it should be completely punched out.
sentences.zh: 理论上，它应该被完全戳掉。

sentences.en: But sometimes it just doesn't happen.
sentences.zh: 但有时并没有发生。

sentences.en: Sometimes the Chads hang on.
sentences.zh: 有时“渣屑”会挂在上面。

sentences.en: And in the case of the 2000 election, if the Chad was still hanging on,
sentences.zh: 而在2000年选举的情况下，如果“渣屑”还挂着，

sentences.en: the ballot counting machine couldn't always read the ballot.
sentences.zh: 计票机并不总能读取选票。

sentences.en: And for the people who would eventually count them by hand in the recount,
sentences.zh: 而对于那些最终在重新计票中进行人工统计的人来说，

sentences.en: The auditors had to interpret the intent of the voter.
sentences.zh: 审计员必须解读选民的意图。

sentences.en: And these hanging Chads became quite infamous as well,
sentences.zh: 这些悬挂的“渣屑”也变得相当臭名昭著，

sentences.en: because in retabulating the vote,
sentences.zh: 因为在重新统计选票时，

sentences.en: you had to make assumptions about whether a hanging Chad was a vote for a particular candidate or it was a mistake.
sentences.zh: 你必须对悬挂的“渣屑”究竟是投给特定候选人的票还是失误做出假设。

sentences.en: That's Eric Herron.
sentences.zh: 那是埃里克·赫伦。

sentences.en: My name is Eric Herron, and I'm the Eberle Family Professor of Political Science at West Virginia University.
sentences.zh: 我叫埃里克·赫伦，我是西弗吉尼亚大学埃伯利家族政治学教授。

sentences.en: And I focus my research on elections, electoral systeMs.
sentences.zh: 我的研究重点是选举和选举制度。

sentences.en: And so because of this faulty ballot in Palm Beach County,
sentences.zh: 所以因为棕榈滩县这张有缺陷的选票，

sentences.en: my grandma Jeannie, a dyed-in-the-wool New Deal Democrat from the Jewish tenements of New York City,
sentences.zh: 我的珍妮奶奶，一位来自纽约市犹太人贫民窟、坚定的“新政”民主党人，

sentences.en: might have accidentally endorsed a third-party candidate who embraces all the things that she is againSt.
sentences.zh: 可能意外地支持了一位拥护她所反对的一切的第三方候选人。

sentences.en: And then when we were told, embarrassed, we felt cheated, we felt guilty.
sentences.zh: 当我们被告知时，感到尴尬，感到被欺骗，感到内疚。

sentences.en: I felt guilty that I voted for the wrong person.
sentences.zh: 我为自己投错了人而感到内疚。

sentences.en: Her retirement community, Century Village, was actually called out by Salon.com and other news outlets
sentences.zh: 她的养老社区“世纪村”实际上被Salon.com和其他新闻媒体点名，

sentences.en: as polling unusually high for Pat Buchanan.
sentences.zh: 称其投给帕特·布坎南的票数异常之高。

sentences.en: There's extensive research to show that the votes cast for Buchanan in Palm Beach County were extraordinarily high.
sentences.zh: 有广泛的研究表明，在棕榈滩县投给布坎南的票数高得惊人。

sentences.en: They were anomalous in the region and in general.
sentences.zh: 它们在该地区乃至总体上都是反常的。

sentences.en: And the best explanation for the spike in support for Patrick Buchanan was the design of the ballot.
sentences.zh: 而对帕特里克·布坎南支持率激增的最佳解释就是选票的设计。

sentences.en: Even Pat Buchanan himself admitted that his high numbers were probably due to an error.
sentences.zh: 甚至帕特·布坎南本人也承认，他高得离谱的票数很可能是由于失误造成的。

sentences.en: Now, the butterfly ballot was only one small piece of the debacle that was the 2000 election in Florida.
sentences.zh: 当然，蝴蝶选票只是2000年佛罗里达州选举这场惨败的一小部分。

sentences.en: A lot of absentee ballots were counted incorrectly.
sentences.zh: 许多缺席选票被错误地统计了。

sentences.en: There was a manual recount that was started and then stopped.
sentences.zh: 人工重新计票开始后又被叫停了。

sentences.en: And later, it would come out that the state of Florida wrongfully denied the right to vote to at least 12,000 people,
sentences.zh: 后来人们发现，佛罗里达州错误地剥夺了至少12,000人的投票权，

sentences.en: a disproportionate number of whom were people of color.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分是有色人种。

sentences.en: All of this in an election where the margin of victory was fewer than 600 votes.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都发生在一场胜负差距不到600票的选举中。

sentences.en: There were a number of incidents in Florida in the 2000 elections that were politically charged and potentially motivated by partisan intent.
sentences.zh: 2000年佛罗里达州的选举中发生了一系列政治化且可能出于党派意图的事件。

sentences.en: But the design of the butterfly ballot is much more likely a case of malpractice than malice.
sentences.zh: 但蝴蝶选票的设计更像是失职而非恶意。

sentences.en: It was a classic design fail.
sentences.zh: 这是一个经典的设计失败。

sentences.en: It's a poorly designed ballot.
sentences.zh: 这是一张设计拙劣的选票。

sentences.en: It is a ballot that does not take into account the way that a voter would look at the ballot and use the particular technology in place at the time,
sentences.zh: 这张选票没有考虑到选民查看选票的方式，以及当时所使用的特定技术，

sentences.en: punch card technology, to cast their vote.
sentences.zh: 即打孔卡技术，来投出他们的选票。

sentences.en: The ballot is a designed object that is critically important for democracy.
sentences.zh: 选票是一个对民主至关重要的设计对象。

sentences.en: But in the United States, it's almost never designed by an actual design professional.
sentences.zh: 但在美国，它几乎从不由真正的专业设计师来设计。

sentences.en: And as such, our liberty is being infringed upon by the tyranny of bad design.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的自由正受到糟糕设计的暴政的侵犯。

sentences.en: One of the oldest recorded instances of a vote is from the ancient Greek play The Humanities by Aeschylus.
sentences.zh: 最早的投票记录之一来自埃斯库罗斯的古希腊戏剧《复仇女神》。

sentences.en: In the story, Orestes is on trial for the murder of his mother.
sentences.zh: 故事中，俄瑞斯忒斯因谋杀母亲而受审。

sentences.en: Twelve jurors line up and take turns placing a stone in one urn to signify guilty or in another urn to signify not guilty.
sentences.zh: 十二名陪审员排成一列，轮流将一块石头放入一个瓮中表示有罪，或放入另一个瓮中表示无罪。

sentences.en: And this motif of the stone as a marker of a vote, it's an image that's stuck.
sentences.zh: 而这种以石头作为投票标记的母题，是一个深入人心的意象。

sentences.en: The word sephos, which means small stone or pebble, is the root of sephology or the study of elections.
sentences.zh: 单词“sephos”，意为小石头或鹅卵石，是“sephology”（选举学）的词根。

sentences.en: And as Eric Heron tells it, himself a sephologist,
sentences.zh: 正如埃里克·赫伦（他本人就是一位选举学家）所说，

sentences.en: the whole stone in the urn setup was not too different than how elections in the United States were originally conducted.
sentences.zh: 这种石头放入瓮中的设置与美国最初进行选举的方式并没有太大区别。

sentences.en: So in the early U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以在早期的美国，

sentences.en: elections, you will find voters casting a voice vote.
sentences.zh: 你会发现选民是通过口头投票来投票的。

sentences.en: They physically had to make their way to the polling place and announce their vote.
sentences.zh: 他们必须亲自前往投票站并宣布他们的投票选择。

sentences.en: And one of the things you do sacrifice is the privacy of your vote.
sentences.zh: 而你牺牲掉的一件事就是投票的隐私性。

sentences.en: Individuals know who you are voting for.
sentences.zh: 个人知道你投给了谁。

sentences.en: And what that can engender is pressure on voters to support one candidate or another.
sentences.zh: 而这可能会导致选民在支持某位候选人时受到压力。

sentences.en: And the polls were not calm places with orderly lines.
sentences.zh: 而且投票站并不是秩序井然、安静的地方。

sentences.en: You could be badgered and pressured into voting a certain way.
sentences.zh: 你可能会被纠缠和施压，被迫以某种方式投票。

sentences.en: Early elections in the United States often featured liquor and violence and fraud.
sentences.zh: 美国早期的选举经常伴随着酒精、暴力和欺诈。

sentences.en: But voters would have to push or shove or be physical to express their right to vote.
sentences.zh: 选民必须推搡、挤压或动用武力来表达他们的投票权。

sentences.en: In fact, an election could be so raucous that it served as an argument for some against women's suffrage.
sentences.zh: 事实上，选举有时会非常喧闹，以至于成为一些人反对女性选举权的论据。

sentences.en: Elections were deemed as inappropriate for women to attend.
sentences.zh: 选举被认为不适合女性参加。

sentences.en: Then, in the late 1800s, election supervisors realized that having people vote by speaking their choices aloud was a terrible idea.
sentences.zh: 后来，在19世纪末，选举监督员意识到让人们通过大声说出选择来投票是个糟糕的主意。

sentences.en: The lack of privacy could lead to coercion.
sentences.zh: 缺乏隐私可能导致胁迫。

sentences.en: And those who did vote their conscience had no way to verify that their vote was being recorded accurately.
sentences.zh: 而那些凭良心投票的人，没有办法核实他们的投票是否被准确记录。

sentences.en: And this all led to the advent of the paper ballot, called a ticket.
sentences.zh: 这一切导致了纸质选票（称为“选票单”）的出现。

sentences.en: But unlike the ballots we have today, these were printed not by the government, but by political parties.
sentences.zh: 但与我们今天拥有的选票不同，这些选票不是由政府印刷的，而是由政党印刷的。

sentences.en: Political parties would print their own ballots that voters would take with them to the polling place.
sentences.zh: 政党会印刷他们自己的选票，选民会带着这些选票去投票站。

sentences.en: Now, these could be printed in newspapers.
sentences.zh: 这些选票可以印在报纸上。

sentences.en: They could be printed by the parties themselves and distributed.
sentences.zh: 它们可以由政党自己印刷并分发。

sentences.en: And the voter would turn in that party ticket.
sentences.zh: 选民会交出那个政党的选票单。

sentences.en: The party tickets would generally only have the candidates from that party on them.
sentences.zh: 政党选票单通常只包含该党的候选人。

sentences.en: So, if, say, you wanted mostly Republicans, you go get a Republican party ticket.
sentences.zh: 所以，比如，如果你主要想要共和党人，你就去拿一张共和党选票单。

sentences.en: And then you cross out the candidates that you don't want.
sentences.zh: 然后划掉你不想要的候选人。

sentences.en: And then either write in or literally cut and paste pieces of paper with your candidates' names onto that ticket.
sentences.zh: 然后写上或者直接剪贴上你想要的候选人名字的纸条到那张选票单上。

sentences.en: And this is the origin of the term to cast a split ticket or a straight ticket.
sentences.zh: 这就是“交叉投票”或“全党投票”这些术语的起源。

sentences.en: But this system also had probleMs.
sentences.zh: 但这个系统也有问题。

sentences.en: For one, parties could make tickets that looked like those of their opponents,
sentences.zh: 首先，政党可以制作看起来像对手选票的选票单，

sentences.en: but actually had their own candidates listed, duping voters into voting for the wrong party.
sentences.zh: 但实际上列出的是他们自己的候选人，诱骗选民投错党派。

sentences.en: Non-standard ballots also created other opportunities for shenanigans,
sentences.zh: 非标准选票也为欺诈行为创造了其他机会，

sentences.en: like racketeering schemes, which facilitated a whole black market of buying and selling votes.
sentences.zh: 比如敲诈勒索计划，这促成了一个买卖选票的黑市。

sentences.en: And so the party ticket system wasn't creating fair elections either.
sentences.zh: 所以政党选票系统也没有创造出公平的选举。

sentences.en: So in the late 19th century, there is an innovation that is imported from abroad.
sentences.zh: 因此在19世纪末，出现了一种从国外引进的创新。

sentences.en: It's called the Australian ballot.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“澳大利亚选票”。

sentences.en: And the Australian ballot is a government-printed ballot
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚选票是一种由政府印刷的选票，

sentences.en: that is distributed to voters who come to a polling place,
sentences.zh: 分发给来到投票站的选民，

sentences.en: and they cast their ballot in private.
sentences.zh: 他们私下投下选票。

sentences.en: And this Australian ballot system was a game-changer.
sentences.zh: 而这种澳大利亚选票系统彻底改变了游戏规则。

sentences.en: First of all, we started treating ballots more like currency.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们开始把选票看得更像货币。

sentences.en: Administrators have to store them securely.
sentences.zh: 管理人员必须安全地储存它们。

sentences.en: They have to store them safely.
sentences.zh: 他们必须妥善保管它们。

sentences.en: They have to maintain a clear chain of custody over them
sentences.zh: 他们必须保持清晰的监管链，

sentences.en: to maintain the integrity of the election process.
sentences.zh: 以维护选举过程的完整性。

sentences.en: They're often printed on special paper to undermine counterfeiting or efforts to commit fraud.
sentences.zh: 它们通常印在特制纸张上，以防止伪造或欺诈行为。

sentences.en: And with the Australian ballot as a point of departure,
sentences.zh: 以澳大利亚选票为出发点，

sentences.en: polling places in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国的投票站

sentences.en: began to see new machines
sentences.zh: 开始出现新的机器，

sentences.en: that interfaced with the official government-printed ballots.
sentences.zh: 这些机器与官方政府印刷的选票进行交互。

sentences.en: There were machines where you pull levers
sentences.zh: 有些机器是通过拉动杠杆来投票的。

sentences.en: or use a metal rod to punch holes out of an optical scan ballot.
sentences.zh: 或者用金属杆在光学扫描选票上打孔。

sentences.en: Like we saw with the butterfly ballot in Palm Beach County, Florida in the 2000 election.
sentences.zh: 就像我们在2000年佛罗里达州棕榈滩县的蝴蝶选票中所看到的那样。

sentences.en: Today, there is tremendous variation in how each county conducts its elections.
sentences.zh: 如今，各县进行选举的方式存在巨大差异。

sentences.en: If you move across a county line,
sentences.zh: 如果你跨过县界，

sentences.en: your polling place could use an entirely different balloting system.
sentences.zh: 你的投票站可能使用完全不同的投票系统。

sentences.en: Because here's the really crazy thing about elections in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为关于美国的选举，有一件非常疯狂的事情。

sentences.en: Unlike much of Western Europe, Canada, Australia, South Africa, India,
sentences.zh: 与西欧大部分地区、加拿大、澳大利亚、南非、印度，

sentences.en: and most other industrialized democracies,
sentences.zh: 以及大多数其他工业化民主国家不同，

sentences.en: the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: runs its elections at a hyper-local level.
sentences.zh: 是在超地方层面进行选举的。

sentences.en: Because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为美国

sentences.en: decentralizes this whole process,
sentences.zh: 将整个过程去中心化了，

sentences.en: you have a patchwork of election procedures all across the country.
sentences.zh: 所以全国各地的选举程序就像打补丁一样各不相同。

sentences.en: And it can vary at the county level or even within some counties
sentences.zh: 而且在县一级，甚至在某些县内部，

sentences.en: as to how ballots are counted and processed.
sentences.zh: 选票的计票和处理方式也可能有所不同。

sentences.en: We do this because that's what the Constitution tells us to do.
sentences.zh: 我们这样做是因为宪法就是这样规定的。

sentences.en: It says that states shall conduct elections,
sentences.zh: 宪法规定由各州进行选举，

sentences.en: and the states generally delegate elections down to municipal governments.
sentences.zh: 而各州通常将选举权下放给市政政府。

sentences.en: Partly because voters have so many things to vote for
sentences.zh: 部分原因是选民需要投票的项目太多，

sentences.en: that each municipal government requires its own ballot.
sentences.zh: 以至于每个市政政府都需要自己的选票。

sentences.en: We vote for so many public officials.
sentences.zh: 我们要投票选出的公职人员太多了。

sentences.en: Everything from president to drain commissioner can be on a ballot.
sentences.zh: 从总统到排水专员，什么都可能出现在选票上。

sentences.en: Yeah, in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 没错，在密歇根州就是这样。

sentences.en: I grew up in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 我是在密歇根州长大的。

sentences.en: You can vote for county drain commissioner.
sentences.zh: 你可以投票选出县排水专员。

sentences.en: And so, given that each county is responsible for running its own elections,
sentences.zh: 因此，鉴于每个县都负责进行自己的选举，

sentences.en: every county is on their own.
sentences.zh: 每个县都只能靠自己。

sentences.en: They could hire a designer to make the ballots.
sentences.zh: 他们可以聘请设计师来制作选票。

sentences.en: They could not hire a designer to make the ballots.
sentences.zh: 他们也可以不聘请设计师来制作选票。

sentences.en: It all depends on what each elections official wants to do.
sentences.zh: 这完全取决于每位选举官员想怎么做。

sentences.en: And that, more than malicious intent,
sentences.zh: 而这，比起恶意企图，

sentences.en: may be how Grandma Jeannie and her ilk voted for the wrong guy in 2000.
sentences.zh: 可能才是珍妮奶奶和她那一类人在2000年投错人的原因。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Pat Buchanan is a religious fundamentalist kind of guy,
sentences.zh: 帕特·布坎南是个宗教原教旨主义者，

sentences.en: not the sort of person that a bunch of Jewish grannies are going to be voting for.
sentences.zh: 并不是那群犹太老奶奶会投票支持的人。

sentences.en: If you had tested out this ballot in a kind of pilot test,
sentences.zh: 如果你在某种试点测试中测试过这张选票，

sentences.en: or run what we call a usability test,
sentences.zh: 或者进行了我们所谓的可用性测试，

sentences.en: even with just a few people,
sentences.zh: 哪怕只是找几个人测试一下，

sentences.en: that this issue would have surfaced pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 这个问题很快就会浮出水面。

sentences.en: That's Dana Chisnell.
sentences.zh: 那是达娜·奇斯内尔。

sentences.en: She's a user experience designer.
sentences.zh: 她是一位用户体验设计师。

sentences.en: And I do applied research about design in voting in elections.
sentences.zh: 我从事关于选举投票设计的应用研究。

sentences.en: Dana, along with her colleague Whitney Quisenberry
sentences.zh: 达娜和她的同事惠特尼·奎森伯里，

sentences.en: with the Center for Civic Design,
sentences.zh: 来自公民设计中心，

sentences.en: have made it their mission to bring design theory and practice to elections.
sentences.zh: 她们的使命是将设计理论和实践引入选举。

sentences.en: In election administration,
sentences.zh: 在选举管理中，

sentences.en: usability testing doesn't get done.
sentences.zh: 可用性测试根本没做。

sentences.en: And pilot testing on these kinds of designs doesn't get done.
sentences.zh: 这类设计的试点测试也没有做。

sentences.en: So, Dana co-authored a set of field guides to ensure voter intent.
sentences.zh: 所以，达娜合著了一套实地指南，以确保选民意图得到准确表达。

sentences.en: Design manuals for elections officials.
sentences.zh: 这是给选举官员看的设计手册。

sentences.en: And the very first one in the series was how to design usable ballots.
sentences.zh: 该系列的第一本就是如何设计可用的选票。

sentences.en: So, one of our recommendations is use lowercase letters.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们的建议之一是使用小写字母。

sentences.en: Use mixed case.
sentences.zh: 使用大小写混合。

sentences.en: Mixed case print is just easier to read than all caps.
sentences.zh: 混合大小写的印刷体比全大写更容易阅读。

sentences.en: This has actually been proven in studies.
sentences.zh: 这实际上已经在研究中得到了证实。

sentences.en: We also say avoid centered type.
sentences.zh: 我们还建议避免使用居中排版。

sentences.en: Centered type is for wedding invitations and wine labels.
sentences.zh: 居中排版是用于婚礼请柬和葡萄酒标签的。

sentences.en: It really doesn't belong on a form, especially one like this.
sentences.zh: 它真的不适合用在表格上，尤其是像这样的表格。

sentences.en: Other recommendations include using big enough type.
sentences.zh: 其他建议包括使用足够大的字号。

sentences.en: In New York, in 2012, I think, they used six-point type on their ballots.
sentences.zh: 我想在2012年的纽约，他们的选票上使用了六号字。

sentences.en: It's not uncommon to find magnifying glasses in New York voting booths.
sentences.zh: 在纽约的投票站里发现放大镜并不罕见。

sentences.en: The Center for Civic Design also recommends using one sans-serif font.
sentences.zh: 公民设计中心还建议使用一种无衬线字体。

sentences.en: If you look at some of these ballots, they look like ransom notes.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看其中一些选票，它们看起来就像勒索信。

sentences.en: There are lots of different type families that are used.
sentences.zh: 里面用了太多不同的字体系列。

sentences.en: The whole thing is just basically screaming at you.
sentences.zh: 整个东西基本上是在对你尖叫。

sentences.en: And we can calm all that down quite a bit by just going with one sans-serif font.
sentences.zh: 而我们只需使用一种无衬线字体，就能让这一切平静下来。

sentences.en: The suggestions in the guidebooks for how to design a good ballot are akin to designing a good anything.
sentences.zh: 指南中关于如何设计好选票的建议，与设计任何好东西的道理是一样的。

sentences.en: When designers get a hold of these things, they're like, this is design 101.
sentences.zh: 当设计师拿到这些东西时，他们会觉得，这简直是设计入门课。

sentences.en: But election officials don't know this.
sentences.zh: 但选举官员不知道这些。

sentences.en: And election officials, unlike normal clients, often have to uphold legislation requiring them to use bad design.
sentences.zh: 而且选举官员与普通客户不同，他们往往必须遵守要求他们使用糟糕设计的法律。

sentences.en: If you go look at election code, in practically every state, design of the ballot is legislated.
sentences.zh: 如果你去查看选举法，在几乎每个州，选票的设计都是由法律规定的。

sentences.en: What the typeface is, what size it should be, what the grid is.
sentences.zh: 字体是什么，字号应该是多少，网格是什么样的。

sentences.en: It's like bad design is legislated.
sentences.zh: 就像糟糕的设计被立法了一样。

sentences.en: Oh yeah, almost exclusively bad design.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，几乎全是糟糕的设计。

sentences.en: So not only do election officials have to apply better design principles to their ballot making,
sentences.zh: 所以，选举官员不仅需要将更好的设计原则应用到他们的选票制作中，

sentences.en: they also need to change laws.
sentences.zh: 他们还需要修改法律。

sentences.en: But one thing that might solve ballots for good is standardizing them.
sentences.zh: 但有一件事或许能彻底解决选票问题，那就是标准化。

sentences.en: It's actually a project which Dana Chisnell and the Center for Civic Design are also working on.
sentences.zh: 这实际上也是达娜·奇斯内尔和公民设计中心正在进行的一个项目。

sentences.en: They've developed a prototype called the Anywhere Ballot.
sentences.zh: 他们开发了一个名为“随处投票”的原型系统。

sentences.en: It's a touchscreen system where you can resize text, adjust contrast, navigate easily,
sentences.zh: 这是一个触摸屏系统，你可以调整文字大小、对比度，轻松导航，

sentences.en: and verify that you've voted for who you meant to vote for.
sentences.zh: 并确认你投给了你想投的人。

sentences.en: And it's open source, so any elections official can use it.
sentences.zh: 而且它是开源的，所以任何选举官员都可以使用它。

sentences.en: Though Dana is quick to admit that it probably won't eliminate all forms of unfairness.
sentences.zh: 尽管达娜很快承认，它可能无法消除所有形式的不公平。

sentences.en: Oh, well, something always goes wrong.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧，总会有什么地方出错。

sentences.en: I just hope that it will not be a major design disaster.
sentences.zh: 我只希望那不会是一场重大的设计灾难。

sentences.en: The election officials' prayer is, may the margins be wide.
sentences.zh: 选举官员的祈祷是，愿票数差距足够大。

sentences.en: May the margins be wide and the odds ever in your favor.
sentences.zh: 愿票数差距足够大，愿好运永远眷顾你。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到这个节目并点赞。

sentences.en: All of us are on Twitter, Instagram, and Spotify.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都入驻了Twitter、Instagram和Spotify。

sentences.en: But to find out more about this story, including cool pictures and links,
sentences.zh: 但要了解更多关于这个故事的信息，包括精美的图片和链接，

sentences.en: and listen to all the episodes of 99% Invisible,
sentences.zh: 并收听《99%无形》的所有剧集，

sentences.en: you must go to 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 你必须访问99pi.org。
